show.description: A RA&W officer, Sher Pathan, deliberately enters one of the country’s most dangerous prisons to uncover the truth behind his sister Dr. Roshini’s mysterious death. Inside, he faces a corrupt warden, ruthless inmates, and deadly secrets. Watch now fantastic thriller "The Hidden King" only on Kuku TV.
